## Organisation and operating model

Healthplus International helps healthcare and aged-care services find, assess, employ and place Healthcare Workers. The organisation applies role-specific readiness and compliance checks, coordinates commencement and provides agreed workforce support and follow-up. It is a healthcare workforce development organisation, not a training institution. HPI recruits, employs and places workers; its public offering should not be described as employer-of-record (EOR) outsourcing.

The host facility directs day-to-day work and clinical supervision. Responsibilities and obligations must be defined for each engagement. HPI does not represent that staffing is immediately available in every region, and it does not guarantee placements.

Source pages:
- [About HPI and service charter](https://healthplusint.com.au/about)
- [Why HPI: workforce development versus staffing](https://healthplusint.com.au/why-hpi)
- [Employer and facility enquiries](https://healthplusint.com.au/employers)

## Workforce categories

- Registered Nurses (RNs): subject to Ahpra registration, scope and experience requirements
- Enrolled Nurses (ENs): subject to Ahpra registration, individual scope and supervision requirements
- Assistants in Nursing (AINs): role-specific qualifications and relevant screening
- Aged Care Workers and personal care workers: aged-care qualifications, experience and relevant screening
- Community and in-home Support Workers: HPI's stated current support-worker offering is not an NDIS provider service
- Allied Health Professionals: professional qualifications, registration where applicable, scope and service fit
- Doctors: enquiries are considered according to defined employer requirements and available capacity

Requirements depend on the position, setting and applicable law. Credential checks may include Ahpra status, identity, work rights, qualifications, references and relevant screening. A qualification alone does not establish competence for every role.

See [Roles and checks](https://healthplusint.com.au/roles).

## Selected allied health placements

Healthplus International recruits, employs and places Allied Health Professionals across Sydney and regional NSW. Matching considers the discipline, caseload, scope of practice and supervision required for defined clinical, outreach and home-based roles.

Enquiries may include occupational therapy, physiotherapy, psychology, podiatry and dietetics, subject to the role requirements and suitable professional availability. Checks include qualifications, Ahpra registration where the profession requires it, relevant professional credentials, experience, identity, work rights, scope, references, screening, licences and insurance appropriate to the profession and setting.

The host service retains clinical governance, local induction and day-to-day professional supervision. HPI acknowledges workforce requests and makes initial contact within one business day to discuss requirements and next steps.

Source: [Selected Allied Health Placements](https://healthplusint.com.au/roles#allied-health)

## Nursing and care placements

HPI recruits, employs and places Registered Nurses, Enrolled Nurses and Assistants in Nursing for hospitals, residential aged care and community services across NSW. HPI coordinates role-specific compliance, rostering and commencement arrangements.

- Placement settings include hospital wards, residential aged care, respite, community and regional services.
- Healthcare Workers register in two steps, providing their résumé, contact details, profession, preferred locations and availability. Compliance documents are requested after the initial review for a suitable role.
- HPI confirms the role brief, presents suitable candidates and provides readiness information to support placement decisions.
- HPI employs the worker. The host facility retains clinical governance, delegation and day-to-day supervision.
- Start-date planning and early-placement follow-up support workers and facilities as the placement settles.

Source: [Nursing and Care Placements](https://healthplusint.com.au/roles#nurses)

## Geographic coverage

The website describes services and workforce interest across Sydney and NSW, including:
- Far West NSW: Broken Hill, Menindee, Wilcannia, Tibooburra
- Western NSW: Dubbo, Bourke, Walgett, Lightning Ridge, Cobar
- Murrumbidgee and Riverina: Griffith, Wagga Wagga, Deniliquin, Hay
- Hunter New England: Newcastle, Maitland, Tamworth, Armidale, Moree, Narrabri, Inverell
- Northern NSW: Lismore, Grafton, Ballina, Casino, Byron Bay
- Mid North Coast: Port Macquarie, Coffs Harbour, Kempsey, Taree
- Central Coast: Gosford and surrounding communities

A listed service area is not evidence of a currently available worker or open position. Regional workforce arrangements are scoped and planned for each engagement.

See [Regional NSW workforce development](https://healthplusint.com.au/regional-nsw-healthcare-workforce) and [Aged care workforce in NSW](https://healthplusint.com.au/aged-care-workforce-nsw).

## For employers and facilities

Discuss the role, location, timing, clinical scope and supervision requirements via the [employer request form](https://healthplusint.com.au/employers#request). HPI acknowledges the request and makes initial contact within one business day, during stated business hours. Roles, compliance, rostering and commencement arrangements are considered for the specific engagement. No public supply guarantee is implied.

## For Healthcare Workers

Register with a résumé, profession, preferred location and availability at the [Healthcare Worker page](https://healthplusint.com.au/work-with-us#apply). Compliance documents are requested after an initial review for a suitable role. Registration is not a guarantee of work or sponsorship.

Internationally qualified nurses may explore [Ahpra registration administrative support](https://healthplusint.com.au/ahpra-registration-support), a separate service; HPI does not grant professional registration or make registration decisions.
